clips.send: A day trader who freezes the moment real cash is on the line sends this to their trading group chat, pure anxious recognition.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the fear of losing money is never really about the money - it only shows up once the money is real.

He uses a day trader as the example: paper trading, no fear, steady wins. Fund the account with real cash, and the same person freezes, hesitates, loses.

The difference isn't skill. It's a fear that wasn't there until there was something real to lose.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you the training Kevin built for talking to your own mind the right way, straight to your messages.

What do you freeze up on the moment it gets real?

clips.start_words: When I was in the Middle East
clips.send: Someone saving for their first house sends this to a friend stuck renting - proof that even billionaires 'window shop' their dreams on purpose.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a Royal family in the Middle East once showed him they already knew, without ever being taught, the exact system wealthy families use to stay motivated.

One piece of it is almost embarrassingly simple: dream building. Drive by the big houses. Look at the cars. Price out the suite that costs $10,000 a night, just to feel what it's like to say yes to it.

It's not materialism. It's training your mind to believe it's possible, on purpose, on a schedule.

Comment MONEY and I'll send you the training on how wealthy families actually think, straight to your messages.

What's the house you drive by and dream about?
